About Me

I help founders, businesses, and engineering teams transform complex requirements into fast, reliable digital products. With a solid foundation in computer science and modern software engineering from BITM, I bridge intuitive UI/UX design with scalable, secure backend systems.

Using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and React Native, I develop software that powers real-world workflows — from fleet charter mobile reservation systems (Journey Fleet) and clean-energy solar telemetry portals (SolarNext) to cultural utsab portals (Agomoni) and travel booking apps. On the backend, I build scalable REST architectures with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, focusing on high data integrity, low-latency API response times, and frictionless booking experiences.

I believe great software is fast, accessible, and maintainable. I write clean, type-safe code, eliminate UI friction, and ship production-ready applications that deliver immediate business value.
